Ben is reading a book about science. Ben wrote about the day in the diary. Ben wants to be a teacher in the future. Door handles are full of germs.
Ben hopes to visit Sydney one day. It takes twenty minutes to get to the morning playground by bike. Ben thinks science is interesting but a little difficult. The volleyball match starts at three.
Ben learned a lot about science. Ben and Mia had great fun there. The weather was rainy that day. Westerners eat noodles with a fork.
Ben plays basketball with Mia every Thursday. Mia is interested in reading. There are always many people at the basketball court.
